lines.beaver: 민지야, 지금은 괜찮아? 어제 일 들었어.
lines.beaver_en: Minji, are you okay now? I heard about yesterday.
lines.beaver_roman: Minjiya, jigeumeun gwaenchana? Eoje il deureosseo.
lines.learner: 아직 좀 억울해. 내 실수가 아니었거든.
lines.en: I still feel wronged. It wasn't my mistake.
lines.roman: Ajik jom eogulhae. Nae silsuga anieotgeodeun.

lines.beaver_en: That must have been a big shock. I heard the team leader scolded only you.
lines.en: Yeah, the shock was so big that I suffered all night.

lines.beaver_en: That's really unfortunate. What did the others say?
lines.learner: 아무도 내 편을 안 들어서 서운했어.
lines.en: Nobody took my side, so I felt hurt.
lines.roman: Amudo nae pyeoneul an deureoseo seounhaesseo.

lines.beaver_en: Then you must have felt really lonely.
lines.learner: 응, 혼자 집에 오는데 너무 서럽더라.
lines.en: Yeah, coming home alone, I felt so sad.
lines.roman: Eung, honja jibe oneunde neomu seoreopdeora.

lines.beaver_en: Aren't you afraid of going to work?
lines.learner: 솔직히 겁나. 또 혼날까 봐 두려워.
lines.en: Honestly, I'm scared. I'm afraid I'll get scolded again.
lines.roman: Soljiki geomna. Tto honnalkka bwa duryeowo.

lines.beaver_en: Aren't you angry at the coworker who made the mistake?
lines.en: I'm angry, but I don't want to hate them.

lines.beaver: 너 진짜 대단하다. 그래도 힘들면 쉬어.
lines.beaver_en: You're really amazing. Still, rest if it's hard.
lines.beaver_roman: Neo jinjja daedanhada. Geuraedo himdeulmyeon swieo.
lines.en: Even if it's hard, I'll go to work tomorrow.

lines.beaver_en: It would be a waste of all your hard work.
lines.learner: 맞아. 그만두면 아쉬움이 클 것 같아.
lines.en: Right. If I quit, I think I'd have big regrets.
lines.roman: Maja. Geumandumyeon aswiumi keul geot gata.

lines.beaver_en: Should I talk to the team leader for you?
lines.learner: 아니, 그건 부담스러워. 내가 말해 볼게.
lines.en: No, that feels like too much. I'll talk to him.
lines.roman: Ani, geugeon budamseureowo. Naega malhae bolge.

lines.beaver_en: Okay. I'm proud of you. Call me anytime.
lines.learner: 고마워. 네가 위로해 줘서 정말 든든해.
lines.en: Thanks. You comforted me, so I feel really reassured.
lines.roman: Gomawo. Nega wirohae jwoseo jeongmal deundeunhae.
